function: DDPM-based digital twin generates synthetic ISAC sensing MIMO channels from 200 original samples, to train a DnCNN sensing-channel estimator and a sensing beamforming network (pp. 3, 10-11).
system: Narrowband ISAC MIMO: two BSs with 32-antenna ULAs (sensing transmitter, echo receiver), K single-antenna UEs, L point targets; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 8).
method: DDPM (U-Net, time embedding, attention) generative model, 200 training channels, 500 epochs, T=200; downstream DnCNN estimator (supervised) and SNR-trained beamforming network use generated data (pp. 8-12).
data_channel: Custom simulator: scatter-model sensing channel with Poisson number of targets (mean 4), Rayleigh communication channels; 200 original, 3200 generated, 2000 test channels (pp. 3, 8, 10).
test_conditions: Same simulator for training and testing; 2000 test channels unseen in training; sweeps of SNR -15 to 10 dB, original size 100-1000, generated size 3200-32000; M=32 fixed (pp. 8-11).
baselines: Learned: GAN-based generator. Non-learned: flip, shift, rotation and their mix as augmentation; LS and LMMSE estimators. Reference: DnCNN trained on the original 200 samples (pp. 8, 11).
metrics: MMD, CDF of channel capacity, t-SNE and loss convergence for generation; NMSE of DnCNN sensing-channel estimation and sensing SNR of the beamforming network (pp. 8-12).
complexity: FLOPs-based order O(E M^2 sum K^2 F F) for offline training and O(T M^2 sum K^2 F F) for online generation (p. 7); same form for GAN (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 3: "The sensing channel adopts the scatter channel model [37]". Custom scatter model with Poisson number of targets and Rayleigh communication channels (pp. 3, 8); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "comparisons are made by evaluating the well-trained model with the same testing dataset which is unavailable during training". This is a held-out set of the same simulator; M=32 and target statistics stay fixed, and only SNR and dataset sizes are swept.
q3_support: p. 8: "We construct a GAN-based DT model to perform data generation". Learned baseline is the GAN generator; non-learned are flip, shift, rotation (p. 8), LS and LMMSE (p. 11); all compared on MMD (Table III, p. 10) and NMSE (Fig. 7, p. 11).
q4_support: p. 7: "The computational complexity of the proposed digital twinning method is measured using the required number of floating point operations (FLOPs)". Orders are given for offline training and online generation.
q5_support: p. 8: "Multiple Monte Carlo simulations were conducted to generate the sensing channel". Own simulator; no code or data link, no public dataset, no measured data.
notes: Area 2: the DDPM digital twin synthesizes ISAC sensing channels (synthesis of the channel). The second application trains a sensing beamforming network (an area 5 function) on the generated channels, but the learned method of the paper is the generator, so area 2. The original data are Monte Carlo simulations of the scatter model, not measurements (p. 8). The number of UEs K is not given. Table III (MMD) read from the page image (p. 10).
